s: strI, (upaDIyate SudDijYAnamatra । upa + DA + AtaScopasarga ityaN + wAp .) rAjYAM DarmmakAmArTaBayEramAtyAderyat parIkzaRam । ityamaraH ॥ DarmmArTakAmamokzadvArA parIkzA । yaTA । “DarmmArTakAmamokzESca pratyekaM pariSoDanEH । upetya DIyate yasmAdupaDA parikIrttitA ॥ arTakAmopaDAByAntu BAryyAH puttrAMstu SoDayet । DarmmopaDABirvviprAMstu sarvvABiH sacivAn punaH” ॥ iti kAlikApurARe 85 aDyAyaH ॥ (“BUyoBUyaScopaDABirviSoDya taM me matisahAyamakaravam” । iti daSakumAracarite viSrutacarite .) padAnAmupAntyavarRaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥
v: strI upa + DA--aN । upaDAne sTApane “DarmmArTakAmamokzESca pratyekaM pariSoDane । upetya DIyate yasmAdupaDA tena kIrttitA” ityukte DarmmArTAdyupanyAsena mantriRAM 2 parIkzaRe, “cintAvantaH kaTAM cakrurupaDABedaBIravaH” BawwiH “arTakAmopaDiByAM tu BAryyAM putrAMSca SoDayet । DarmopaDABivEprAMSca sarvvABiH sacivAn punaH” kAlikA pu॰ । 3 Cale ca । “upaDABiSca yaH kaScit paradravyaM harennaraH” manuH “taccApi SrutvA BUyoBUya upaDABiH” daSaku॰ । 4 upAye ca । “ayaSoBidurAloke kopaDA maraRAdfte” mAGaH । “alo'ntyAt pUrvva upaDA” pARinyukte antyavarRRAt 5 pUrvvavarRe ca । “anOpaDAlopano'nyatarasyAm” “kopaDAcca” pA॰ । liNgAnuSAsanasUtre kopaGAt KopaDAdityAdi mUriprayogaH 6 upADO ca । upaDABftaH ।
m: 1. उप-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to place or lay upon, place near to, put on or into; to place, lay, put, RV. x, 87, 3; 145, 6; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn.; Ragh. &c.; to put to, yoke (horses), RV. iv, 29, 4; to give or make over, hand over (knowledge), teach, Ragh.; to impose, lay upon, commit, consign, Ragh.; to place under one's self, lie down upon, R.; to place in addition, add, connect, AitBr.; ŚBr.; Lāṭy. &c.; to communicate, cause to share in; to use, employ; (in Gr.) to lie or be placed close to, precede without the intervention of another syllable, RPrāt. &c.; to cause to rest upon or depend on BhP.
2. उप-धा f. imposition, forgery, fraud, deceit, trick, false pretence, MBh.; Mn.; R.
trial or test of honesty (of four kinds, viz. of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage), Kām.; Bhaṭṭ.; Śiś. &c.
(in Gr.) a penultimate letter, Pāṇ.; RPrāt.; APrāt.; Nir. &c.
condition, reservation, L.
a: उपधा — {c3c} U. 1 To place or lay upon, place under or in; अधिजानु बाहुमपधाय Śi. 9. 54; उपहितं शिशिरापगमश्रिया मुकुलजालमशोभत किंशुके R. 9. 31; Bk. 15. 47; Ku. 1. 44; हृदि चैनामुपधातुमर्हसि R. 8. 77 treasure uplay to heart; Ms. 4. 54; उपहितसूक्ष्मग्रंथिना Ś. 1. 19. --2 To place, lay; वामहस्तोपहितवदना Ś. 4 resting on. --3 (a) To place near; Mv. 4. 56. (b) To put to or yoke (as a horse to a carriage &c.). --4 To cause, bring on or produce; Mk. 1. 53. --5 To impose, entrust with, charge with (as a duty); तदुपहितकुदुंबः R. 7. 71. --6 To lay a command upon, enjoin, instruct in (with acc.); स्त्रीषु नृत्यमुपधाय शिक्षयन् R. 19. 36. --7 To lie down upon, use as a pillow; उपधाय वामभुजमशयिषि Dk. 111. --8 To apply, employ, lay or bestow upon, क्रिया हि वस्तूपहिता प्रसीदति R. 3. 29. --9 To place over, cover, conceal. --10 To add, place in addition. --11 To communicate, impart, give, bestow; उपहितशोभा Bk. 2. 55. --12 To locate; एतदुपहितं चैतन्यं Vedānta S. --13 (In gram.) To precede without the intervention of another syllable.

उपधा — 1 Imposition, forgery, fraud, deceit, trick, pretence; Ms. 8. 193. --2 Trial or test of honesty, (धर्माद्यैर्यत्परीक्षणं); (said to be of 4 kinds, {1} loyalty, {2} disinterestedness, {3} continence, {4} courage); (शोधयेत्) धर्मोपधाभिर्विप्रांश्च सर्वाभिः सचिवान् पुनः Kālikā P. --3 A means or expedient; अयशोभिदुरा लोके कोपधा मरणादृते Śi. 19. 58. --4 (In gram.) A penultimate letter (अंत्याद्वर्णात्पूर्व उपधा) --Comp. --भृतः a servant who has been guilty of dishonesty. --शुचि a. tried, of approved loyalty.

k.v: साहसं तु दमो दण्डः साम सान्त्वमथो समौ। भेदोपजापावुपधा धर्माद्यैर्यत्परीक्षणम्.।

उप-धानी f. a pillow, cushion
footstool (see पादोप˚), MBh.

उप-धानीय n. a pillow, cushion, Pañcat.
a: उपधानीय — a. To be placed near. --यं A pillow.

s: klI, (upaDIyate Aropyate mastakamatra । upa + DA + aDikaraRe lyuw .) SiroDAnam ॥ vAliSa iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । upavarhaH 2 । ityamaraH । gaRquH 3 । iti jawADaraH । (“sopaDAnAM DiyaM DIrAH sTeyasIM Kawwayanti ye” । iti mAGaH 2 । 77 । “pawwopaDAnADyAsitaSiroBAgena” । iti kAdambarI .) vizam । praRayaH । iti medinI । vratam । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: na॰ upaDIyate Siro'tra upa + DA ADAre lyuw । (vAliSa) 1 SiroDAne । karaRe karmaRi vA lyuw । 2 praRaye, vrataBede, hema॰ । 3 viSeze 4 praRaye ca viSvaH “sopaDAnAM DiyaM DIrAH sTeyasIM Kawvayanti ye” mAGaH । “sopraDAnAM saviSezAM, pakze sagendukAmiti” malli॰ “pawvopaDAnADyAsitaSiroBAgeRa” kAda॰ । “AsandI sopaDAnA dakziRAnaqvAn yavASca” kAtyA॰ 21, 4, 30 । 5 vize medi॰ BAve lyuw । 6 samIpasTApane na॰ । karaRe lyuw । 7 upaDAnasADane mantre pu॰ “tadvAnAsAmupaDAnomantraH” pA॰
m: उप-धान mfn. placing upon, employed or used in placing upon (as a Mantra in the setting up of the sacrificial bricks), Pāṇ. iv, 4, 125
उप-धान n. the act of placing or resting upon, KātyŚr.; Kauś.
that on which one rests, a pillow, cushion, AV. xiv, 2, 65; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
cover, lid, Car.; Hcat.
peculiarity, singularity, excellence (cf. प्रेमोप˚), Bālar.; Siddh.
affection, kindness
religious observance
poison, L.
(also) fetching, procuring, Jātakam.
a jewel-case, ib.
a: उपधान — a. Used (as a Mantra) in the putting up of the sacrificial bricks; P. IV. 4. 125. --नं 1 Placing or resting upon. --2 A pillow, cushion; विपुलमुपधानं भुजलता Bh. 3. 79. --3 Peculiarity, individuality (विशेषं); फलोपाधानाभावात् P. VI. 3. 39 Sk. --4 Affection, kindness. --5 A religious observance. --6 Excellence or excellent quality; सोपधानां धियं धीराः स्थेयसीं खट्वयंति ये Śi. 2. 77. (where उ˚ also means a pillow). --7 Poison.

2. उप-धार्य ind.p. having taken or held up &c.

s: puM, (upa sAdfSye । DAtusadfSo DAtuH .) azwapraDAnaDAtusadfSaDAtuH । sa tu saptaDA yaTA । mAkzikam 1 tutTakam 2 aBram 3 nIlAYjanam 4 manaHSilA 5 haritAlam 6 rasAYjanam 7 ॥ SarIrasTaDAtuBavopaDAtuH saptaDA yaTA । rasAt stanadugDam 1 raktAt strIrajaH 2 mAMsAt vasA 3 medaso Garmma 4 asTno dantaH 5 majjanaH keSaH 6 SukrAt ojaH 7 । iti vEdyakam ॥ (“stanyaM rajaSca nArIRAM kAle Bavati gacCati । SudDamAMsaBavasnehaH sA vasA parikIrttitA ॥ svedo dantAstaTA keSAstaTEvojaSca saptamam । iti DAtuBavA jYeyA ete saptopaDAtavaH” ॥ iti SArNgaDareRa pUrvvaKaRqe paYcame'DyAye uktam ॥ “saptopaDAtavaH svarRamAkzikaM tAramAkzikam । tutTaM kAMsyaM ca rItiSca sindUraSca SilAjatu” ॥ iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTamaBAge ॥)
v: pu॰ upa sAdfSye prA॰ sa॰ । KarRAdipraDAnaDAtusadfSezu “saptopaDAtavaH svarRamAkzikaM tAramAkzikam । tutyaM kAMsyaYca rItiSca sindUraYca SilAjatu” BAvapra॰ uktezu saptasu 1 dravyezu । “upaDAtuzu sarvvezu tattadDAtuguRA api । santi kintvezu te gORAstattadaMSAlpaBAvataH” BAvapra॰ । tatra katamasya dravyasya katamopaDAtutvaM tannirRRitaM tatrEva । “kiYcit suvarRRasAhityAt svarRRamAkzikamIritam । upaDAtuH suvarRRasya kiYcit svarRRaguRAnvitam” । tAramAkzikamanyattu tadBavedrajatopamam । kiYcidrajatasAhityAt tAramAkzikamIritam” 2 “tutTaM (tu~te) tAmropaDAturhi kiYcittAmreRa tadBavet । kiYcittAmraguRaM tasmAdvakzyamARaguRaYca tat” 3 । upaDArtuBavet kAMsyaM dvayostaraRiraNgayoH । kAMsyasya tu guRAjYeyAH svayInisadfSAjanEH 4 । rotirapyupaDAtuH syAttAmrasya yaSadasya ca । pittalasya guRAjYeyAH svayonisadfSA guREH” 5 । sIsopaDAtuH sindaraM guREstat sIsavanmatam । saMyogaja praBAvena tasyApyanye guRAH smftAH” 6 । nidAGe DarmmasantatyA satuzAraM DarADarAH । niryAsavat pramuYcanti tacCilAjatu kIrttitam । sOvarRRaM rAjataM tAmramAyasaM taccaturviDam 7 । iti caturRRAM svarRRAdInAmupaDAtutvAt SilAjatunaScaturdDA BedaH । etezAmanyAnyaguRAstattacCabde vakzyante । BAvapra॰ etaevopaDAtutvena gaRitAH Sabdakalpa॰ svarRRamAkzikatutTakarpUrakAlAYjanamanaHSilAharitAlarasAYjanarUpA upaDAtava ityuktaM tanmUlaM mfgyam । SarIrasTezu rasAdijanyezu 2 stanadugDAdizu ca । dehasTAH rasAdayaH sapta DAtavaH teByo jAtASca zaqupa DAtavaH । tatra rasAt stanadugDam । raktAt strIrajaH 2 mAMsAt vasA 3 । medaso DarmmaH 4 । asTnodantaH 5 । majjataH keSaH 6 । SukrAt ojaH 7 । yaToktaM SArNgaDara । “stanyaM rajovasAsvedo dantAH keSAstaTEva ca । OjasyaM saptaDAtUnAM kramAt saptopaDAtavaH” । tatra BAvama॰ stanyAdi svarUpamuktaM yaTA “vanitAnAM prasUtAnAM DamanIByAM stanOgatAt । rasAdeva hi jAyeta stanyaM stanayugASrayam । SudDamAMsasya yaH snehaH sA vasA parikIrttitA । medasastApyamAnasya sneho vA kaTitA vasA” ।
m: उप-धातु m. a secondary mineral, semi-metal (seven are specified: स्वर्ण-माक्षिक, pyrites; तार-माक्षिक, a particular white mineral; तुत्थ, sulphate of copper; कांस्य, brass; रीति, calx of brass; सिन्दूर, red lead; शिलाजतु, red chalk), Bhpr.
secondary secretions and constituents of the body (viz. the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph), ŚārṅgS. &c.
a: उपधातुः — 1 An inferior metal, semimetal. They are seven; सप्तोपधातवः स्वर्णं माक्षिकं तारमाक्षिकं . तुत्थं कांस्यं च रातिश्च सिंदूरं च शिलाजतु ... --2 A secondary secretion of the body (six in number); e. g. milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph; स्तन्यं रजो वसा स्वेदो दंताः केशास्तथैव च . औजस्यं सप्तधातूनां क्रमात्सप्तोपधातवः ...

a: उपधाव् — {c1c} U. 1 To run towards, approach hastily. --2 To resort to. --3 To run, glide (A.).

a: उपधिः — [उप-धा-कि] 1 Fraud, dishonesty; अरिषु हि विजयार्थिनः क्षितीशा विदधति सोपधि संधिदूषणानि Ki. 1. 45, see अनुपधि also. --2 (In law) Suppression of the truth, a false suggestion; Ms. 8. 165. --3 Terror, threat, compulsion, false inducement; बलोपधिविनिर्वृत्तान् व्यवहारान्निवर्तयेत् Y. 2. 31, 89. --4 The part of a wheel between the nave and the circumference, or the wheel itself. --5 Foundation (with the Buddhists).
उपधिः — See under उपधा.
